verified_environment.objective: maximize banked coins at the final record

farmer_priority: water wheat that has already missed one day
harvest wheat at age 4 or later
plant wheat while planting remains open
market_policy: hold wheat while price is below 35, shed stock is below 72, and day is before 25
sell all shed wheat when price reaches 35
sell all shed wheat when stock reaches the 72-unit safety cap
liquidate all remaining shed wheat from day 25 onward
buy enough seeds to maintain six concurrent wheat crops
do not buy seeds after day 24

generalization_validation.decision: passed; keep v9 as the verified control

trajectory_dataset.status: schema and checkpointed collection complete; not yet sufficient for policy improvement
trajectory_dataset.feature_boundary: decision-time observations are separate from post-decision and terminal outcomes
trajectory_dataset.limitation: one behavior policy provides observed outcomes only; training now would imitate v9 rather than estimate counterfactual choice value

counterfactual_market_dataset.method: clone the exact live state, force one HOLD or SELL WHEAT choice while preserving all other actions, then return both branches to frozen v9
determinism_checks: source state remains unchanged by branch execution
identical cloned branches produce identical next states
resolved episode seed is explicitly copied into clone info
baseline episode scores reproduce the trajectory dataset
counterfactual_market_dataset.important_engine_finding: kaggle-environments clone() omits env.info; the collector must copy it or future weed and shop randomness incorrectly falls back to seed 0

first_value_model.target: terminal SELL minus HOLD coins after one forced choice
first_value_model.best_grid_interpretation: depth-0 constant HOLD over the sampled states
first_value_model.decision: do not promote; deeper state-dependent trees overfit and the best constant intervention is not a robust learned policy

hard_safety_rules: fall back to v9 outside prices 28-40
preserve all farmer and seed decisions

second_overnight_run.decision: keep v9; the learned candidate improved average cash and 9 of 10 fresh seeds but failed the every-seed consistency gate

threshold_refinement.decision: do not promote threshold 36; it failed the predeclared every-seed improvement gate on the independent holdout

next_experiment.name: broader counterfactual coverage for a state-dependent value model
next_experiment.hypothesis: additional prices, days, and inventory levels can reduce rare costly errors that made shallow trees worse than v9
steps: keep v9 threshold 35 frozen as the submission control
use development seeds only for additional state branching and model selection
sample broader prices, days, and stock levels with policy-hash and seed provenance
group train and validation splits by seed so both player positions never cross splits
require a state-dependent model to beat v9 leave-one-seed-out regret before any full policy rollout
reserve seeds 50-59 as the next untouched promotion holdout

must_not_do: do not train on outcomes from the same seed used for model validation
do not call behavior cloning a policy improvement
do not reuse seeds 20-29 to select another candidate

learning_roadmap.decision: use a hybrid system: deterministic safety and action legality around learned scoring components
learning_roadmap.phase_1_complete: explicit heuristics and parameter search established mechanics, accounting, and the reproducible v9 control
learning_roadmap.phase_2_complete: v9 passed generalization and a leak-resistant single-policy trajectory dataset was collected
learning_roadmap.phase_3_complete: deterministic state branching produced the first true HOLD/SELL counterfactual labels and an interpretable model baseline
learning_roadmap.phase_4_now: broaden counterfactual coverage until a state-dependent model beats v9 under leave-one-seed-out regret
learning_roadmap.phase_5: evaluate one selected model on fresh held-out seeds and opponents while retaining v9 as a deterministic fallback
learning_roadmap.phase_6: consider offline RL or self-play only after the state, action, reward, and holdout protocols are stable
rl_entry_requirements: terminal banked cash and win outcome tracked correctly
promotion only when repeated results beat frozen v9 without reliability regressions

one_goose_experiment.status: eligible after v9 generalization, but deferred while the market-learning slice is isolated
one_goose_experiment.why_goose_first: cheaper and earlier-producing than cow or sheep

verified_costs_and_needs.feed: carried WHEAT; grass is not used
verified_costs_and_needs.fertilizer: one collectable unit per surviving animal per day

one_goose_experiment.placement_rule: place near the shed or directly on a stable route, not at the farthest tile
one_goose_experiment.reason: feeding, harvesting, care, and fertilizer collection all require visits; distance is recurring overhead
setup_actions: BUY_ANIMAL GOOSE as a market order
PICKUP carried wheat for future FEED actions
promotion_gate: include every setup, feed, harvest, care, collection, and movement turn
compare the same seeds and both positions
promote only if wins are preserved and repeated banked cash increases

do_not_do: do not treat one favorable game as proof
do not compare reports from different simulator versions
do not tune and report performance on the same seed set
do not reuse a spent holdout to select a new candidate
do not train on one deterministic policy and claim it learned a better policy
do not jump directly to sparse terminal-reward RL over raw actions
do not let a learned component bypass legal actions or deterministic safety limits
do not count carried or shed inventory as final profit
do not place a daily-service animal far away merely because its production interval is long
do not add animals, fertilizer, routing, and market timing in one candidate
do not submit without loading main.py by file
do not move agent above another callable in main.py
do not install competition packages into the global Python environment
